thread:
Anya: Short sync — cust_123 (payments) wants a tight 2-week pilot: eval-triggered alerts + automated quantization recommendations + sensible batching/caching defaults. Can we keep scope minimal?
Mike: I can own batching + caching defaults. Need SLO targets (p50/p95/p99) and explicit tail constraints.
Kevin: Two profiles make sense: latency-first (low wait, small batches) and throughput-first (larger batches). Also need per-tenant qps caps to avoid noisy neighbors.
Claire: Customer request: alert when golden_set concordance drops >5% and suggested action should be a single-click rec like "apply int8 + kv-cache". Is 5% too tight?
Srini: For payments flows 5% is ok. Suggest categorizing prompts: critical (<=5%), non-critical (<=10%). For quant recs: split into SAFE (int8 + smoke perf check) and BETA (int4 + sampling). We should auto-run a small eval before surfacing SAFE recs.
Mike: Draft defaults for pilot: batching_profile: latency-first, max_batch_size: 12, max_wait_ms: 10, kv_cache: enabled, cache_ttl_sec: 300. Will propose an API: POST /optimize/v1/recs {model, avg_seq_len, traffic_profile, eval_set_id} -> returns list of ranked recs.
Claire: Alert UX: must be opt-in per-route. Payload: {drift_pct, affected_prompts, suggested_action, risk_level, example_inputs}. Provide quick rollback path link.
Jen: Ops notes: eval-alert -> create incident ticket + optional webhook to customer pager. Retain eval artifacts 30d. Add rate limiting: max 3 alerts per eval_set per 24h.
eval-bot: eval-run complete for cust_123 — golden_concordance drop 6.2% ⚠️ Recommended: SAFE -> enable int8 + kv_cache.
Kevin: If we auto-suggest quant changes, require a canary: route 5% traffic to quantized variant for 24h, compare latency and error metrics. Auto-revert if error delta > 2% or p99 latency increases > 30ms.
Anya: Action items: Mike -> PR with batching defaults + API sketch. Srini -> quant rec logic + staging eval harness. Claire -> alert acceptance criteria & UX copy. Jen -> ops runbook, retention, rate-limit. Kevin -> canary safety checks and rollback thresholds. Meeting tomorrow 9:30 to lock scope.
Mike: Will put up PR by EOD.
Srini: I'll prototype int8 gating in staging and wire test harness.
Claire: Drafting acceptance criteria doc, will link here.
Jen: Stubbing runbook now.
Anya: Keep pilot narrow and measurable. Ping if blockers.
